name: Chameleon Simulator
summary:
Become a chameleon and dive into a colorful world of chameleon survival, exploration, chaos, and relaxing fun in Chameleon Simulator.

See the world from a chameleon’s point of view as you run, hide, survive, and escape from a dangerous granny. Explore beautiful chameleon environments, discover playful activities, and experience every area as a curious chameleon.
